lines.t: But which real assets actually express it?
Paste a thesis, an article, a tweet or a PDF.
SyntheTick pulls out the idea, plus your rules: only crypto, only European ETFs, no defense.
It searches stocks, ETFs, bond funds and crypto.
A hard filter in the database means a rule can never be broken.
An analyst model picks up to ten assets.
Each gets a score from zero to one hundred, and a clear reason.
Then two audits check every pick: one in code, one against your own words.
Anything that breaks a rule is dropped, and you see why.
If nothing qualifies, it says so.
If a data vendor has no number, you see a dash.
And now all of it is open source, under the MIT license.
